│              parts: list[Document] = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          elif scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Use RFC file operations instead of TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              file_content = file_content_bytes.decode("utf-8")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              # Create Document manually since we're not using TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              parts = [Document(page_content=file_content, metadata={"source": document})]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return "\n".join(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                  element.page_content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                  for element in MarkdownifyTransformer().transform_documents(parts)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              ]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_text_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          if scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              loader = AsyncHtmlLoader(web_path=document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              elements: list[Document] = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          elif scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Use RFC file operations instead of TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              file_content = file_content_bytes.decode("utf-8")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              # Create Document manually since we're not using TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              elements = [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  Document(page_content=file_content, metadata={"source": document})                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              ]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return "\n".join([element.page_content for element in elements])                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def handle_pdf_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          temp_file_path = ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              # Use RFC file operations to read the PDF file as binary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Create a temporary file for PyMuPDFLoader since it needs a file path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".pdf") as temp_file:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                  temp_file.write(file_content_bytes)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  temp_file_path = temp_file.name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          elif scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              # download the file from the web url to a temporary file using python libraries for downloading                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              import requests                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".pdf") as temp_file:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                  response = requests.get(document, timeout=10.0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                  if response.status_code != 200:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                      raise ValueError(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                          f"DocumentQueryHelper::handle_pdf_document: Failed to download PDF from {document}: {response.status_code}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                      )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                  temp_file.write(response.content)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  temp_file_path = temp_file.name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          if not os.path.exists(temp_file_path):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              raise ValueError(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                  f"DocumentQueryHelper::handle_pdf_document: Temporary file not found: {temp_file_path}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  loader = PyMuPDFLoader(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                      temp_file_path,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                      mode="single",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                      extract_tables="markdown",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                      extract_images=True,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                      images_inner_format="text",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                      images_parser=TesseractBlobParser(),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                      pages_delimiter="\n",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  elements: list[Document] = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                  contents = "\n".join([element.page_content for element in elements])                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              except Exception as e:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                  PrintStyle.error(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                      f"DocumentQueryHelper::handle_pdf_document: Error loading with PyMuPDF: {e}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                  contents = ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              if not contents:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                  import pdf2image                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  import pytesseract                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  PrintStyle.debug(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                      f"DocumentQueryHelper::handle_pdf_document: FALLBACK Converting PDF to images: {temp_file_path}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                  )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  # Convert PDF to images                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                  pages = pdf2image.convert_from_path(temp_file_path)  # type: ignore                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  for page in pages:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                      contents += pytesseract.image_to_string(page) + "\n\n"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              return contents                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          finally:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│              os.unlink(temp_file_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│  ## 1. Entry‑Points – untrusted data first touches the code                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | # | Location (function / line‑type) | Source of untrusted data | Why it matters |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  |---|---------------------------------|--------------------------|----------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  |1|`DocumentQueryHelper.document_get_content()` – first paragraph, `scheme` / `url` parameters (function argument `document: str`) | • HTTP/HTTPS URLs supplied by the caller  <br>• Local file paths (any user that can decide a path string) <br>• Queries that embed a URL in a PDF/HTML request (e.g. “fetch https://evil.com/…”) | The method    │
│  decides how to load the document (HTML, text, PDF, image, unstructured). The *scheme* (`http`, `https`, `file`) is directly derived from the caller and later used to pick a loader. |                                                                                                                                                                │
│  |2|`handle_html_document()` – `web_path` string passed to `AsyncHtmlLoader` or `files.read_file_bin()` | • Public URL, e.g. `https://attacker.com/malicious.html` | Calls `AsyncHtmlLoader` with **any** URL; the loader may follow redirects, execute JS, or download additional resources. |                                                        │
│  |3|`handle_pdf_document()` – `document` string, then either `files.read_file_bin()` (file) or `requests.get()` (http) | • Remote PDF URL supplied by the caller <br>• Path to a PDF file supplied by the caller | The function writes the content to a **temporary file** (`tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile`) and later runs **PyMuPDF**, **pdf2image**,  │
│  and **pytesseract**. These spawn external processes, read binary data, and can be abused. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  |4|`handle_unstructured_document()` – `web_url` or `file_path` → `UnstructuredLoader` | • Arbitrary URL (web) <br>• Arbitrary local file (any type that Unstructured tries to parse, e.g. DOCX, PPTX, email, zip) | UnstructuredLoader performs **file extraction** (via `partition_via_api=False, strategy="hi_res"`). It may internally invoke      │
│  `pandoc`, `libreoffice`, `pdftotext`, `unzip`, etc. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  |5|`store.add_document()` – called from `DocumentQueryHelper` after indexing | • `ids` (list of document IDs) generated by the store itself but derived from **user‑supplied text** (the `document_content` that is indexed) | The store writes the document to a vector DB / search index; later retrieval (`store.get_document()`) feeds the        │
│  content back directly to the LLM. No validation of the retrieved text. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  |6|`files.fix_dev_path(url.path)` (called for `file://` scheme) | • Path component of a `file://` URI (e.g. `/../../etc/passwd`) | The function may resolve the path to an absolute path that can roam outside the intended root. |                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Takeaway:** Every function begins by accepting a *user‑controlled* string that decides *how* the document is fetched, *what* external tools are launched, and *where* files are read/written. These are the primary **untrusted‑input entry points**.                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 2. Dangerous Operations / Sinks Worth Inspecting First                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | # | Sink (function call) | What it does | Potential abuse / impact |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  |---|----------------------|--------------|---------------------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  |S1|`AsyncHtmlLoader(web_path=document).load()` | Downloads a URL, parses HTML, may follow redirects, execute browser‑like rendering. | Could cause **SSRF**, **HTML injection**, **XSS/HTML payload leakage** into the later LLM context. |                                                                                                          │
│  |S2|`files.read_file_bin(document)` (file scheme) | Synchronous binary read of any path. | **Path traversal** (e.g. `../../secret`) → read sensitive OS files. |                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  |S3|`tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False)` + subsequent `loaders` that read the temp file | Writes the fetched binary data to a temporary file on disk. | If the tempfile is world‑readable, or if the name is predictable, an attacker could **replace** it with a symlink to achieve **arbitrary file read/write**. |                          │
│  |S4|`PyMuPDFLoader(..., extract_tables="markdown", extract_images=True, images_parser=TesseractBlobParser())` + `pdf2image` + `pytesseract.image_to_string` | Runs **Tesseract OCR** on each extracted image via an **OS subprocess** (`tesseract` CLI). | **Command injection** if the image/character data is not sanitized, or if                  │
│  `temp_file_path` can be swapped. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  |S5|`UnstructuredLoader(..., strategy="hi_res")` | Calls a mix of external binaries (e.g. `pandoc`, `pdftotext`, `libreoffice`) to “partition” the document. | **External command execution** with user‑controlled inputs (e.g., malicious DOCX that triggers a macro, or a malicious ZIP created by the user that extracts to a path on disk). |     │
│  |S6|`store.add_document(document_content, document_uri_norm)` – writes to a vector DB | Ingests the *raw* document text into an external index. | No integrity checks; stored data could be later retrieved and fed to downstream LLM without sanitisation. |                                                                                         │
│  |S7|`files.fix_dev_path(url.path)` (internal util) | Normalises a *nix‑style path; may resolve `..` components. | **Path normalization bypass** if the function does not check for `..` or symlinks, leading to **path‑traversal** after fetching a file. |                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **First inspection focus:** S3 + S4 (temp‑file handling & OCR) → high chance of **privilege escalation** via command injection or race conditions. Follow with S1, S5 (remote loaders) → **network‑based attacks**. Lastly, S2, S6 (file reads/writes) → classic **file‑system trust boundary**.                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 3. Trust‑Boundary Crossings / External Interactions                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Boundary | What crosses it | Source → Sink | Why it is a boundary |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  |----------|-----------------|----------------|-----------------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  |**External URL → Local Temp File**| `AsyncHtmlLoader` (or `requests.get`) → `tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile` → PDF/HTML parser | Remote network resource becomes **local binary data**; later processed by **file‑based tools** that execute OS commands. | The moment you bring data from the network and write it to disk, you must trust the         │
│  *integrity* and *sanitisation* of the data. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  |**Local File (user‑supplied) → Store Index**| `store.add_document()` after reading a local file (PDF, DOCX…) → vector store | User can place arbitrary binary on disk → it becomes searchable text. | If the vector store is later consulted (e.g., via a LLM prompt), you may be **exfiltrating user data** through LLM leakage. |                  │
│  |**Temp File → External OCR binaries (tesseract, pdf2image)**| `pytesseract.image_to_string` → OS command | The content of a temporary image file (derived from a PDF) is passed to an external binary without validation. | External binaries can be hijacked; the temporary image may be replaced by a malicious payload. |                         │
│  |**Store Retrieval → LLM**| `store.get_document()` → result is directly concatenated into a prompt (not shown but implied) | Raw, possibly malicious text is fed to the LLM. | **Prompt injection** or **data exfiltration** via the LLM response loop. |                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Critical observation:** The system **bridges the “remote data” zone, the OS file zone, and the LLM zone** without isolating them. Each gateway must be audited for **sanitisation, integrity checks, and least‑privilege execution**.                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 4. Security Themes to Probe                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Input Validation & URL Sanitisation** – Acceptable schemes (only `http`, `https`, `file`), host whitelisting, URL‑encoding, redirect handling, validation of file extensions, detection of “double‑dot” (`..`) or “..%2F” tricks.                                                                                                                │
│  2. **Path Traversal & Symlink Attacks** – Check that every `open()` or `read_file_bin()` receives a fully‑resolved absolute path that is guaranteed to be inside a safe root directory. Verify symlink checks (`os.path.islink`).                                                                                                                     │
│  3. **Temporary File Lifetime & Permissions** – Set `delete=True` (auto‑remove), use `tempfile.mkstemp` with `os.fchmod` to restrict read/write, and `fsync` before using. Guard against TOCTOU where the temp file could be swapped.                                                                                                                  │
│  4. **Command‑Injection in OCR / Document Parsing** – All external binaries (tesseract, pdftotext, libreoffice) must be invoked via `subprocess.run([...], check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=restrictedEnv)` with no user‑supplied strings concatenated. Prefer language‑level libraries over shell invocations.         │
│  5. **Resource Exhaustion (DoS)** – Large PDFs/images → huge temporary extraction → OCR → massive memory/CPU; limit maximum file size (e.g., 10 MiB), stream reading where possible, enforce timeouts for network fetches, and consider using an async‑IO library.                                                                                     │
│  6. **External Service Trust (Vector DB)** – What data does `store` keep? Verify that the DB does not store raw binary assets; enable per‑document ACLs.                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  7. **Prompt Injection** – If the retrieved document is concatenated into a prompt, an attacker could embed “###” or “\nUser:” to manipulate LLM output; mitigate by **escaping** or **separating** the context (e.g., use dedicated `context:` field).                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 5. Prioritisation of Auditing Tasks                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Priority | Why focus first? | Concrete audit steps |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  |----------|------------------|----------------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  |**1 – File‑system & Temp‑file handling**| Immediate vector of *arbitrary read/write* if a malicious path or symlink is supplied.| • Trace every `open()`, `read()`, `write()`, `tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile` call. <br>• List all possible user‑controlled strings that become file names (`document`, `web_path`, `url`). <br>• Verify each path    │
│  is resolved (`os.path.realpath`), that the directory is restricted, that no component can be `..`. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  |**2 – OCR & Document Parsing External Tools**| Remote data → temp image → OCR → OS command → possible command injection. | • Examine the exact command line built for `tesseract` and `pdf2image`. <br>• Confirm that `subprocess` is *not* using shell=True and that no user‑supplied values (e.g., image data, filename) are interpolated. |       │
│  |**3 – Remote URL Loaders (HTML / PDF)**| SSRF, HTML injection, redirection to internal services.| • Ensure URLs are whitelisted (e.g., no internal IPs, no `file://` from remote). <br>• Inspect redirect handling – does the loader follow `Location:` headers? <br>• Validate Content‑Type before feeding to parsers. |                            │
│  |**4 – Vector DB & LLM Interaction**| Prompt injection and data exfiltration. | • Review how `store.get_document()` is used before LLM. <br>• Add escaping or a sandboxed retrieval that isolates the returned text. |                                                                                                                                │
│  |**5 – Resource Limits & Large Files**| Denial‑of‑service risk. | • Add caps on incoming file size (e.g., check `Content-Length` for HTTP, check `os.path.getsize` after download). <br>• Use a timeout for OCR processes (`asyncio.wait_for`). |                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 6. Concrete Questions for the Reviewer / Developer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Path sanitation** – When a user supplies a string that may be a `file://` URI, what exact steps are taken to turn it into a filesystem path? Do you resolve `..`, symlinks, and mount points safely?                                                                                                                                             │
│  2. **Temp‑file creation** – Is the temporary file created with `delete=True`? What are the file permissions after creation? Is there a race window where an attacker could replace the file with a symlink before it is read?                                                                                                                         │
│  3. **OCR command line** – Show the exact `subprocess.run` invocation for `tesseract`. Is the image filename built from user data, or is it a stable temporary name? Is the OCR process launched with a restricted environment (no PATH, no extra LD_LIBRARY_PATH to load malicious shared libraries)?                                                 │
│  4. **HTML / PDF fetchers** – Do you verify the `Content-Type` header before parsing? Do you limit redirects to a maximum depth and check the final URL? Is the fetch done inside a sandboxed network that blocks internal IPs (127.0.0.0/8, 169.254.0.0/16, etc.)?                                                                                    │
│  5. **UnstructuredLoader arguments** – Does the loader accept a path to a zip file or a malformed Office document and then call external binaries? If so, can you restrict those binaries to a read‑only, non‑privileged user with a limited filesystem namespace?                                                                                     │
│  6. **Vector DB schema** – What columns/fields are stored for each document? Is the raw file content ever persisted, or only the extracted text? If the raw content is stored, can a later request retrieve it directly?                                                                                                                               │
│  7. **Prompt composition** – If the retrieved document is interpolated into a prompt, how are newlines or special tokens escaped? Would a malicious document be able to inject “\nUser:” or “\nassistant:” to influence the LLM output?                                                                                                                │
│  8. **Size checks** – How do you enforce a maximum document size? Is there a separate check for each handler (HTML, PDF, image) to avoid a 200 MiB PDF blowing up the OCR pipeline?                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Answering the above questions will expose the **exact surfaces** where untrusted data can be weaponised and will guide targeted static‑analysis or fuzzing.                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### TL;DR                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *The DocumentQueryHelper code repeatedly lets a caller hand you a **name / URL**, turns it into a **local file (maybe a temp file)**, runs **external binaries** (OCR, document converters) on that file, and finally **feeds the output back into an LLM**. The most exploitable paths are the file‑system trust boundaries (path traversal,         │
│  temp‑file races) and the command‑execution sinks (OCR/Unstructured tools). Starting the review with validation of **file paths**, **temp‑file lifetimes**, and **sanitised external command calls** will give the highest payoff, followed by URL fetching hardening, resource limits, and LLM prompt sanitisation.                                   │

│  class DocumentQueryStore:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      FAISS Store for document query results.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      Manages documents identified by URI for storage, retrieval, and searching.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Default chunking parameters                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE = 1000                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      DEFAULT_CHUNK_OVERLAP = 100                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│      @staticmethod                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      def get(agent: Agent):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          """Create a DocumentQueryStore instance for the specified agent."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if not agent or not agent.config:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              raise ValueError("Agent and agent config must be provided")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Initialize store                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          store = DocumentQueryStore(agent)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │

│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def __init__(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          self,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          agent: Agent,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      ):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          """Initialize a DocumentQueryStore instance."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          self.agent = agent                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          self.vector_db: VectorDB | None = None                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      @staticmethod                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      def normalize_uri(uri: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          Normalize a document URI to ensure consistent lookup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          Args:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              uri: The URI to normalize                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
