│  | Component | What the attacker can supply | Why it matters |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  |-----------|-----------------------------|----------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  | **URL to process** (`file://`, `http(s)://`) | Scheme, hostname, path, redirects, file name | May point to arbitrary files, remote payloads, or give a chance to read system files. |                                                                                                                                                               │
│  | **Remote data** (content of the URL) | Size, type, malformed binary | Large payloads can exhaust memory; binary tricks can evade simple MIME checks. |                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  | **External binaries** (`tesseract`, `poppler.utils`, etc.) | The program **calls** these binaries with paths it constructed (e.g. a temporary PDF on disk). | If the binary is invoked with a crafted filename you can trigger command‑injection, buffer‑overflows, or privilege‑escalation. |                                                      │
│  | **Prompt text** (what you later send to the LLM) | The extracted text is interpolated into a prompt. | An attacker could embed instruction‑like strings that the LLM interprets (prompt injection). |                                                                                                                                               │
│  | **Running environment** | The worker process runs as a certain OS user, inside a container, with a set of installed packages. | High‑privilege execution gives the attacker more leeway to read/write files you didn’t intend. |                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  The goal of the hardening is to **remove any path that leads to file‑system access, arbitrary network fetches, or prompt injection** while still allowing legitimate document extraction.                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 2. Harden the **URL → File** entry point                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 2.1 Whitelist only safe schemes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  from urllib.parse import urlparse, urljoin, unquote                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  from pathlib import Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ALLOWED_SCHEMES = {"http", "https", "file"}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  ALLOWED_ROOT   = Path("/data/user_docs")           # mandatory root for file:// URLs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  ALLOWED_HOSTS  = {"docs.mycompany.com", "static.example.org"}   # for http/https                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def safe_url_to_path(url: str) -> Path:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      """Return a Path that points inside ALLOWED_ROOT, or raise."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      parsed = urlparse(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      if parsed.scheme not in ALLOWED_SCHEMES:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          raise ValueError(f"Unsupported URL scheme: {parsed.scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      if parsed.scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          # Remove leading "file://", resolve, then enforce root confinement                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          raw_path = unquote(parsed.path)                # decode %2F etc.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          raw_path = Path(raw_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          resolved = raw_path.resolve()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Confine to the allowed root                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          rooted = resolved.relative_to(ALLOWED_ROOT.resolve())                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          return resolved        # already points to a safe location                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          # For http/https we never materialise a local file here – we fetch later.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          raise ValueError("http/https URLs are not materialised locally yet")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *If the URL is `file:///etc/passwd`* → `resolved` will be `/etc/passwd`; the `relative_to` check fails because it is **not** under `/data/user_docs`. The handler aborts.                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 2.2 Create a *per‑request* temporary directory inside the whitelist                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  import tempfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  import shutil                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def make_temp_dir() -> Path:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      # prefix makes it easier to clean up after a specific request.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="docproc_", dir=ALLOWED_ROOT))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      os.chmod(tmp, 0o700)      # no other user on the host can touch it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      return tmp                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  All files that the handler creates (downloaded PDF, OCR output, etc.) will live inside this directory. Cleanup is deterministic:                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  def clean_up_dir(tmp_dir: Path):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 3. Protect the **network fetch** (for http/https URLs)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 3.1 A “safe fetcher” that resolves redirects *and* checks host/IP                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  import requests                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  from ipaddress import ip_network, ip_address                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  class SafeFetcher:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      def __init__(self, max_size: int = 10 * 1024 * 1024, timeout: int = 5):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          self.session = requests.Session()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          self.max_size = max_size                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          self.timeout = timeout                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # Hard‑code the allowed IP network(s) if you prefer checking IP directly.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          self.allowed_ips = {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              ip_network("198.51.100.0/24"),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def _allowed_host(self, host: str) -> bool:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          # Simple allow‑list (preferred) – can be complemented by IP check below                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          return host in {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│              "docs.mycompany.com",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              "static.example.org",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def _resolve_redirects(self, start_url: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          cur = start_url                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          for _ in range(3):           # 2 redirects + 1 extra check                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              resp = self.session.head(cur, allow_redirects=False,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                        timeout=self.timeout)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              if resp.status_code not in (300, 301, 302):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                  break                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              location = resp.headers.get("Location")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              if not location:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                  raise ValueError("Redirect with no Location header")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│              # Resolve relative URLs against current one                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              cur = urljoin(cur, location)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # WHOLESALE host + IP check                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              parsed = urlparse(cur)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              if not self._allowed_host(parsed.hostname):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                  raise ValueError(f"Disallowed host: {parsed.hostname}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              # Optional: resolve to IP and verify membership                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  ip = ip_address(parsed.hostname)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                  if ip not in self.allowed_ips:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                      raise ValueError(f"IP {ip} not in allowed ranges")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              except ValueError:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                  # hostname not an IP – we already checked host name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                  pass                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError("Too many redirects")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          return cur                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      def load(self, url: str) -> bytes:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"}:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              raise ValueError("URL must be http/https")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          final_url = self._resolve_redirects(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # GET the final URL                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          resp = self.session.get(final_url, stream=True,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                  timeout=self.timeout, allow_redirects=False)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          if resp.status_code != 200:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              raise RuntimeError(f"GET failed: {resp.status_code}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          # Enforce size before reading whole body                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          total = 0                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          chunks = []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          for chunk in resp.iter_content(chunk_size=8192):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│              total += len(chunk)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│              if total > self.max_size:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                  raise ValueError("Remote payload exceeds size limit")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│              chunks.append(chunk)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          return b"".join(chunks)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *Key points*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * **No `allow_redirects=True` on the final GET** – we manually chase redirects after checking each hop.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  * **Size limit** (`max_size`) prevents OOM.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  * **Explicit host whitelist** – stops a domain‑change attack.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  * Returns raw bytes that we can safely write to a file **inside our temp dir**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 3.2 Store the fetch result safely                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  def write_fetched_payload(url: str, payload: bytes, tmp_dir: Path) -> Path:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      # Preserve the original filename when possible – use the URL's path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      parsed = urlparse(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      filename = Path(unquote(parsed.path)).name or "anonymous.bin"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      out_path = tmp_dir / filename                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      out_path.write_bytes(payload)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      out_path.chmod(0o600)      # only the worker user can read                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      return out_path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 4. Guard the **external binaries** (`tesseract`, `pdfinfo`, etc.)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 4.1 General rules                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Rule | Rationale |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  |------|-----------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  | Run the binary **as a non‑root OS user** (e.g. `docproc`). | Even if the binary is compromised, the attacker can’t affect the rest of the host. |                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  | Keep the binary in a **read‑only, non‑world‑writable location** (`/usr/local/bin` owned by root, mode `0755`). | Prevent tampering by the process user. |                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  | **Never pass a user‑supplied path that could contain “..” or be a symlink**. Use only paths that live inside the request‑specific temp directory. |                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  | **Capture stdout/stderr** and log them; never `os.system` or `subprocess.Popen` with `shell=True`. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  | Set a **CPU / memory timeout** (e.g. `ulimit -t` for time, `--timeout` options if available). |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 4.2 Example: OCR a downloaded PDF with `tesseract`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  import subprocess                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def ocr_pdf(pdf_path: Path, tmp_dir: Path) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Runs `tesseract` on the *first* page of `pdf_path`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Returns the extracted text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      Preconditions:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│        - pdf_path lives inside `tmp_dir`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│        - `tmp_dir` has mode 0700 and belongs to the `docproc` user.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # 1️⃣ Verify we have a *regular* file (no symlinks)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      if not pdf_path.is_file():                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          raise RuntimeError("PDF is not a regular file")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # 2️⃣ Use absolute path inside the known temp dir                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      pdf_abs = pdf_path.resolve()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      out_txt = tmp_dir / (pdf_path.stem + ".txt")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 3️⃣ Run tesseract with explicit arguments, no shell                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      cmd = [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          "tesseract",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          str(pdf_abs),                     # input file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          str(out_txt.with_suffix("")),     # output base (no extension)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          "pdf",                           # OCR PDF                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          "lang", "eng",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          "psm", "1",                      # Page segmentation mode                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      ]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Capture both stdout & stderr for debugging; set timeout                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      env = {"PATH": "/usr/local/bin"}     # make sure we pick the read‑only binary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      proc = subprocess.run(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          cmd,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          stdout=subprocess.PIPE,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          stderr=subprocess.PIPE,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          env=env,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          timeout=30,                      # seconds – abort if it hangs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          text=True,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 4️⃣ Log the command and output for audit                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      print("[OCR] cmd:", " ".join(cmd))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      print("[OCR] stdout:", proc.stdout)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      print("[OCR] stderr:", proc.stderr)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      if proc.returncode != 0:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          raise RuntimeError(f"Tesseract failed: {proc.stderr}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # 5️⃣ Read the OCR result (still inside tmp_dir)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
