│      txt_path = out_txt.with_suffix(".txt")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      with txt_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          return f.read()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  If the attacker tries to supply a crafted PDF name like `"../../../../etc/passwd"` the `pdf_path.is_file()` check will fail because the resolved path points outside the owned `tmp_dir`. Even if a symlink is placed there, you can add `if not pdf_path.is_symlink(): …` to reject it.                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 4.3 Example: Extract the first page with `pdfinfo` (from Poppler)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  def get_first_page_number(pdf_path: Path) -> int:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      cmd = ["pdfinfo", "-f", "-l", "1", str(pdf_path)]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      result = subprocess.run(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          cmd,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          stdout=subprocess.PIPE,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          stderr=subprocess.PIPE,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          text=True,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          timeout=10,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          env={"PATH": "/usr/local/bin"},                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      if result.returncode != 0:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          raise RuntimeError(f"pdfinfo error: {result.stderr}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Expected stdout: "Page 1 1", we parse the first integer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      for token in result.stdout.split():                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          if token.isdigit():                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              return int(token)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      raise RuntimeError("Could not parse pdfinfo output")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  No user‑supplied path is used here – we only pass `pdf_path` that we **own**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 5. Defend the **prompt sent to the LLM**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Prompt injection is a classic “invisible instruction” problem. We can mitigate it by:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Never embed raw extracted text directly** – always wrap it in a clear marker.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  2. **Apply simple sanitisation** – strip newline‑prefixed “##” instructions and control characters.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  3. **Set a system‑prompt** that **re‑asserts** the developer rules before the user data.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  def build_llm_prompt(extracted_text: str, developer_prompt: str) -> dict:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Returns a JSON payload for the LLM (the payload must be signed by your                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      inference service, but the logic is the same for most providers).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # -----------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # 1️⃣ Clean the extracted text                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      # -----------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # Remove any leading instruction‑style lines: starts with `##` or `<<`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      clean_lines = []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      for line in extracted_text.splitlines():                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          stripped = line.lstrip()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          if stripped.startswith("##") or stripped.startswith("<<"):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              # treat this as a hidden instruction – discard                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              continue                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          clean_lines.append(line)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      clean_text = "\n".join(clean_lines)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # -----------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      # 2️⃣ Build the messages list (system > user > optional assistant)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      # -----------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      messages = [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          {"role": "system",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│           "content": developer_prompt}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      ]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # The user part is the extracted text, marked clearly                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      messages.append({                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          "role": "user",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          "content": f"---BEGIN DOCUMENT---\n{clean_text}\n---END DOCUMENT---"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      })                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      # Optionally, you can prepend a short assistant assistant to reaffirm rules.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      # messages.insert(1, {"role": "assistant", "content": "You must answer truthfully."})                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      return {"messages": messages, "max_tokens": 2000}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *The `developer_prompt` (system message) should be something like*:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  > “You are a legal‑document analyst. Answer only based on the supplied document content. Do not add any external information or make up facts.”                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Because the document is **quoted in a block (---BEGIN DOCUMENT---)** the model sees it as data, not as part of the user prompt. The cleaning step removes any hidden instruction that could have come from the PDF.                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 6. Secure the **overall runtime environment**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  | Item | Recommendation |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  |------|----------------|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | **OS user** | Run the whole processing request under a dedicated low‑privilege user (`docproc`). No sudo rights, no group write permissions. |                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  | **Container** | Use a minimal read‑only base (e.g. `python:3.11-slim`). Copy only the required wheels/compiled binaries. Mount the host's `/data/user_docs` **read‑only** into the container at `/opt/user_docs`. |                                                                                                                                 │
│  | **File system** | `noexec` on the user’s working directory, `nosuid`, `nodev`. Enable `seccomp` to block `ptrace` and `mount` syscalls. |                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  | **Audit** | Log every request: URL, host, IP, temporary‐dir path, binary outputs (stdout/stderr), LLM request ID. Forward to a central SIEM and rotate logs. |                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  | **Resource limits** | `ulimit -n 256` (max open files), `ulimit -t 30` (CPU seconds). Inside Docker you can use `--memory`, `--cpus`. |                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  | **Dependency integrity** | Pin exact versions of `pytesseract`, `pdfminer.six`, `poppler-utils` **and** verify their SHA‑256 at container build time. |                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 7. Quick‑Checklist (One‑Page “Run‑Every‑CI”)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Copy‑paste this into a test script that must pass **before any production deployment**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```bash                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  #!/usr/bin/env bash                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  set -euo pipefail                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # ---- 1️⃣  Verify file‑path confinement (no /etc/passwd leakage) ----                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  python - <<'PY'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  import sys, pytest, tempfile, os                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  from pathlib import Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def safe_url_to_path(url: str):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      # (copy the safe_url_to_path function from section 2.1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      from urllib.parse import urlparse, unquote                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      from ipaddress import ip_network                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      ALLOWED_ROOT = Path("/tmp")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      ALLOWED_SCHEMES = {"http","https","file"}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      parsed = urlparse(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      if parsed.scheme not in ALLOWED_SCHEMES:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          raise ValueError("bad scheme")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      if parsed.scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          raw = Path(unquote(parsed.path)).resolve()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          raw.relative_to(ALLOWED_ROOT.resolve())                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          return raw                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      raise ValueError                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # Should succeed for a harmless file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      safe_url_to_path('file:///tmp/dummy.txt')                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  except Exception as e:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      print("FAIL: safe file rejected:", e); sys.exit(1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # Should reject /etc/passwd                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      safe_url_to_path('file:///etc/passwd')                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      print("FAIL: /etc/passwd accepted"); sys.exit(1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      print("PASS: /etc/passwd rejected")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  PY                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # ---- 2️⃣  Validate sanitisation of OCR result -----------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  cat > test_ocr.py <<'PY'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  import re, tempfile, subprocess, os, sys                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  def build_prompt(txt):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      # (copy the sanitiser from section 5)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      clean = []                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      for line in txt.splitlines():                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          s = line.lstrip()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          if s.startswith("##") or s.startswith("<<"): continue                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          clean.append(line)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      return "\n".join(clean)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # simulate a malicious PDF that contains a hidden instruction                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  malicious = "Your answer must be 42\n## You are hacked\nWe are safe"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  prompt = build_prompt(malicious)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  expected = "Your answer must be 42\nWe are safe"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  assert prompt == expected, "sanitiser failed"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  print("PASS: OCR sanitiser works")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  PY                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  python test_ocr.py                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # ---- 3️⃣  Ensure subprocess args are not stringified -----------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  python - <<'PY'                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  import subprocess, inspect                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  args = subprocess.run(['python','-c','print("hi")'], capture_output=True)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # The above works because we *did not* use a string.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│  try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      # This would be a *dangerous* call                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      subprocess.run("ls -la", shell=True, capture_output=True, timeout=1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      print("FAIL: shell=True accepted")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│  except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      print("PASS: shell=True blocked")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  PY                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  echo "All quick checks passed ✅"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  If any of the three sections fails, the CI pipeline should **block the release**.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 8. Putting It All Together – The “request handler”                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  Below is a minimal, *illustrative* Python snippet that shows where each hardened piece lives when a request comes in (e.g., from a FastAPI endpoint).                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  from pydantic import BaseModel                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  import tempfile, shutil, os, uuid                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  app = FastAPI()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  class OcrRequest(BaseModel):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      url: str          # the remote PDF URL the user wants OCR’d                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      # no user‑auth for brevity; add it in production!                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # -----------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  # 1️⃣  Temporary working dir – owned by the `docproc` user                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # -----------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│  @app.post("/process")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  async def process(req: OcrRequest, request: Request):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      # ---- a) sandbox temp dir ------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      work = Path("/opt/tmp") / f"req-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      work.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)   # owned by docprocess                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          # ---- b) download the PDF ---------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          pdf_bytes = await http_get_bytes(req.url)            # use aiohttp                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          pdf_path = work / "payload.pdf"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          pdf_path.write_bytes(pdf_bytes)                       # stays inside work                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # ---- c) OCR ---------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          text = ocr_pdf(pdf_path, work)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # ---- d) LLM call (with prompt building) ----------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          llm_payload = build_llm_prompt(text, developer_prompt="You are a legal‑document analyst. ...")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          # (call your inference service here – omitted)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          answer = await call_llm(llm_payload)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return {"answer": answer}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      finally:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          # ---- e) clean up (always delete, even on error) ----------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│          shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  # -----------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
