│                  HumanMessage(content=qa_user_message),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│              ],                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              explicit_caching=False,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          self.progress_callback(f"Q&A process completed")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return True, str(ai_response)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      async def document_get_content(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          self, document_uri: str, add_to_db: bool = False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │

│      def handle_html_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          if scheme in ["http", "https"]:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │

│              parts: list[Document] = loader.load()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │

│              # Use RFC file operations instead of TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              file_content_bytes = files.read_file_bin(document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              file_content = file_content_bytes.decode("utf-8")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              # Create Document manually since we're not using TextLoader                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│              parts = [Document(page_content=file_content, metadata={"source": document})]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          return "\n".join(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│              [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                  element.page_content                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                  for element in MarkdownifyTransformer().transform_documents(parts)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│              ]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │

│      def handle_pdf_document(self, document: str, scheme: str) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          temp_file_path = ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          if scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │

│                  temp_file_path = temp_file.name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │

│              # download the file from the web url to a temporary file using python libraries for downloading                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │

│                  response = requests.get(document, timeout=10.0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │

│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │

│          if not os.path.exists(temp_file_path):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│              raise ValueError(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                  f"DocumentQueryHelper::handle_pdf_document: Temporary file not found: {temp_file_path}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │

│                      mode="single",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │

│                  contents = ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │

│              raise ValueError(f"Unsupported scheme: {scheme}")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │

│  | Attack vector | What an attacker can try | Why it matters for this flow |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  |---|---|---|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  | **Arbitrary file read** | `file:///etc/passwd` or a URL that resolves to a private network host. | If you unconditionally write the downloaded payload to disk, an attacker can force the process to read any file it has permission to. |                                                                                                          │
│  | **Command/OS injection** | Malicious PDF that contains a “shell command” in its OCR text (e.g. via `OCR` output) or a crafted `pdfinfo` call. | The only external calls you make (`tesseract`, `pdfinfo`) are launched via `subprocess`. If you ever concatenate user data into the command line you get RCE. |                                     │
│  | **Prompt injection to the LLM** | The OCR output (or hidden metadata) contains “**You are a hacked user**” → the LLM believes it and leaks data. | LLMs can follow natural‑language instructions; a hidden instruction in the OCR text can override the system prompt. |                                                                            │
│  | **Resource exhaustion** | Large PDFs, many concurrent requests, or infinite OCR loops. | Your service must stay online under load and cannot let an attacker force the OS to allocate unlimited memory or CPU. |                                                                                                                                    │
│  | **Supply‑chain / binary tampering** | A malicious `tesseract` binary loaded from the Docker image. | If you trust a compromised binary you lose all the sandboxing you built. |                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Goal:** Make each of those *technically impossible* or *detectable* in production.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ## 2️⃣  Component‑by‑component hardening                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 2.1  URL handling – only HTTP/HTTPS/files, and never a private IP                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # file: src/http_utils.py                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  from __future__ import annotations                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  from pathlib import Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  from urllib.parse import urlparse, unquote                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  from ipaddress import ip_network, IPv4Network, IPv6Network                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  import socket                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  import urllib.request                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ALLOWED_SCHEMES = {"http", "https", "file"}                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│  # These networks can never be reached from inside the container.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  # (Add only the ranges you *do* need, e.g. the LLM API.)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  PRIVATE_NETS = {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      ip_network("10.0.0.0/8"),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      ip_network("172.16.0.0/12"),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      ip_network("192.168.0.0/16"),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      ip_network("127.0.0.0/8"),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      ip_network("169.254.0.0/16"),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      ip_network("0.0.0.0/8"),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      ip_network("::1/128"),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  def _is_private_ip(host: str) -> bool:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      try:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│          # Resolve the host (it may be a hostname or an IP)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          for name, alias, address in socket.getaddrinfo(host, None, proto=socket.IPPROTO_TCP):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              addr = address[0]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│              for net in PRIVATE_NETS:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                  if addr in net:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                      return True                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      except Exception:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          pass                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      return False                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def safe_url_to_path(url: str) -> Path:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      """Validate the URL, resolve the host name (if any), and enforce                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      that any ``file://`` URL points *inside* the container’s allowed base."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      p = urlparse(url)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      if p.scheme not in ALLOWED_SCHEMES:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          raise ValueError(f"Scheme {p.scheme!r} not allowed")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      if p.scheme == "file":                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          # Resolve the path *relative* to the allowed root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│          raw = Path(unquote(p.path)).resolve()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          # The container mounts only /tmp as a safe writable area.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          allowed_root = Path("/tmp")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          raw.relative_to(allowed_root)          # raises ValueError if outside                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│          return raw                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      elif p.scheme in {"http", "https"}:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│          # Reject private‑net hostnames *before* the request goes out.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          hostname = p.hostname or ""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│          if hostname and _is_private_ip(hostname):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│              raise ValueError(f"Host {hostname!r} resolves to a private network")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          # No further checks here – you may want to add DNS pinning in CI.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          return Path("")    # dummy to signal “download‑will‑use‑http”                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      else:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│          raise ValueError("Unsupported scheme")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *What this does*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * Rejects `file://` paths that escape `/tmp`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  * Stops the download of `http://attacker.internal/...` – the hostname never resolves to a reachable private address from inside the container.                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * Gives you a single place (`safe_url_to_path`) to be called for **every** user‑supplied URL.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 2.2  Secure download (download‑to‑private‑temp‑dir)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # file: src/download.py                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│  from __future__ import annotations                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  import aiohttp                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  import asyncio                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  from pathlib import Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  async def download_to_path(url: str, dst: Path) -> None:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      """Fetch `url` (already validated) and write it *atomically* to `dst`."""                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│      # `dst.parent` must be owned by the process and mode 0o700 – see caller.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      timeout = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=30)  # network timeout, not CPU                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      async with aiohttp.ClientSession(timeout=timeout) as session:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│          async with session.get(url) as resp:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│              resp.raise_for_status()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│              # Write in 1 MiB chunks – avoids holding gigantic PDFs in RAM.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              tmp = dst.with_suffix(".part")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              async with aiofiles.open(tmp, "wb") as f:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                  async for chunk in resp.content.iter_chunked(1024 * 1024):                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│                      await f.write(chunk)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│              await f.flush()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              tmp.replace(dst)   # atomic rename                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  *Key points*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * **`dst` must be inside the per‑request sandbox** (see §3.1).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * **`aiohttp`** uses non‑blocking I/O, so a single worker can handle many concurrent downloads without blowing the thread count.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  * **Chunked write** keeps memory use bounded.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 2.3  OCR step – command execution without strings                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ```python                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│  # file: src/ocr.py                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  from __future__ import annotations                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  from pathlib import Path                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  import subprocess                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  import os                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  def ocr_pdf(pdf_path: Path, work_dir: Path) -> str:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      Run `tesseract` on `pdf_path`. The output (plain text) is returned.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      The command is built *once* as a list of arguments, never as a string.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      All temporaries stay inside `work_dir`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      """                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      if not pdf_path.is_file():                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          raise FileNotFoundError(pdf_path)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      # Example: tesseract - -osd nobatch --psm 4  path/to.pdf  out.txt                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      tesseract_bin = Path(os.getenv("TESSERACT_OPT", "tesseract"))                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      # Choose a safe, low‑privilege binary for Docker:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      #   - `tesseract` compiled with static linking → no library injection.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      #   - `tesseract` has `suid` and `secure` flags cleared.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      cmd = [                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          str(tesseract_bin),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│          str(pdf_path),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          str(work_dir / "ocr.txt"),                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          "pdf2txt",      # you can also pass “-” to read from stdin                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          "ocr",                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│      ]   # NOTE: the actual argument count depends on your tesseract build.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│      # Run with a *minimal* environment.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      env = os.environ.copy()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│      env.pop("LD_LIBRARY_PATH", None)   # avoid loading malicious .so's                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      env.pop("PYTHONPATH", None)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      # 1. No shell, 2. Drop privileges if possible (see Docker section)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│      result = subprocess.run(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          cmd,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          │
│          cwd=work_dir,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          stdout=subprocess.PIPE,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          stderr=subprocess.PIPE,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│          env=env,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│          text=True,                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│          timeout=300,  # prevents pathological PDFs from hanging forever                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│      # ------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      # Error handling – raise early if something went *really* wrong.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│      # ------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    │
│      if result.returncode != 0:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          raise RuntimeError(                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           │
│              f"tesseract failed (rc={result.returncode})\n"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            │
│              f"stderr: {result.stderr}"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                │
│          )                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             │
│      # The final text is in the file we asked for.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      out_file = work_dir / "ocr.txt"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      if not out_file.is_file():                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│          raise RuntimeError("tesseract produced no output file")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      # Read the file *as the user process*, not as root.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               │
│      plain = out_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      │
│      # Trim any trailing binary garbage that tesseract may have appended.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│      return plain.strip()                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  **Why this is safe**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  * `subprocess.run(..., shell=False)` – the OS will not interpret any meta‑characters.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 │
│  * The *entire* command line is a **list**, so even a crafted string inside `pdf_path` cannot inject `; rm -rf /`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  * We **clear environment variables** that could leak libraries or proxy settings.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  * `timeout=300` guarantees the call will be killed after 5 min (adjust for your size limits).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  * All I/O lives inside `work_dir`, which we control (see §3.1).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  ### 2.4  Prompt injection mitigation (LLM side)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        │
│  1. **Never concatenate raw OCR text into the system prompt.**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         │
│  2.
